scientific_integrity: All-parameter conclusions are proved analytically by Poisson summation and strict hyperbolic monotonicity; finite numerical calculations only check formulas and local sample behavior. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unit-period Zak transform only; no general dilated-lattice frame set is determined.
The comparison with historical literature is bounded and may miss obscure equivalent formulations.
Nondegenerate Zak zeros are not by themselves a quantitative stability bound.
title: Exactly three simple Zak zeros for odd rational windows with two imaginary pole pairs
